content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Sells protein shakes and sports nutrition foods through retailers, a packaged-food business unlike Peloton's connected fitness hardware and streaming subscriptions."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"B2B payment, telemetry and vending software for machine operators; no consumer fitness hardware or class subscriptions."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Designs and sells UGG, HOKA and Teva footwear and apparel; a footwear brand, not connected fitness equipment or streaming."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Wholesale apparel, outerwear and footwear sourcing and licensing sold to department stores; no fitness equipment or subscriptions."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Nutrition and weight-management products sold through independent distributors, a multi-level marketing model unlike Peloton's direct equipment sales."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Digital publishing and advertising business monetized through ads and affiliate commissions, with no hardware or subscription fitness product."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Franchised physical gym memberships; members use clubs rather than connected home equipment or streaming classes."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Televised and online retail of third-party merchandise; a reseller of consumer goods, not a maker of connected fitness products."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Branded protein bars, shakes and snacks sold through grocery retailers; packaged foods, not fitness equipment or streaming."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Private-label home furnishings and kitchenware sold through stores and websites; a home retailer, not connected fitness."}]}
